## Checklist
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] Plugin / Neovim gates pass if those changed (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Spec in `docs/spec/` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Regression test added for a bug fix
- [ ] No secrets, no personal server addresses
